system_overview: This specification defines a utility library for zero-indexed sequences, providing operators analogous to the standard one-indexed sequence operators. In this module, a sequence of length n is represented as a function with domain {0, 1, ..., n-1} rather than the standard {1, 2, ..., n}. The module provides constructors, accessors, conversions, lexicographic ordering, and rotation operators for these zero-indexed sequences.
actors_and_components: There are no concurrent actors. This is a purely definitional library module providing reusable operators for zero-indexed sequence manipulation. It is used as a dependency by other specifications that require zero-based indexing.
state_variables: There are no state variables. This is a constant-level module with no state machine.
initial_state: NOT_SPECIFIED -- there is no state machine.
actions: NOT_SPECIFIED -- there is no state machine. The module defines the following operators: (1) The empty zero-indexed sequence (the empty tuple). (2) An indices operator that returns the domain of a zero-indexed sequence, or the empty set for the empty sequence. (3) A set constructor that produces all zero-indexed sequences of elements from a given set, as the union over all natural-number lengths. (4) A length operator using the cardinality of the domain. (5) A conversion operator from one-indexed to zero-indexed sequences (shifting indices down by one). (6) A conversion operator from zero-indexed to one-indexed sequences (shifting indices up by one). (7) A lexicographic less-than-or-equal comparison that recursively compares elements position by position, with shorter sequences considered smaller when one is a prefix of the other. (8) A rotation operator that shifts a sequence left by a given number of positions, wrapping around using modular arithmetic. (9) A rotations operator that produces the set of all rotations of a sequence, each tagged with its shift amount.
safety_properties: NOT_SPECIFIED -- there is no state machine.
liveness_properties: NOT_SPECIFIED -- there is no state machine.
model_bounds: NOT_SPECIFIED -- as a library module, bounds are determined by the importing specification.
additional_assumptions: The module locally imports standard library modules for finite set cardinality, natural number arithmetic, and one-indexed sequence operations. These imports are local, meaning they are not re-exported to modules that import this one. The empty sequence is represented as the empty tuple, which serves as both the zero-indexed and one-indexed empty sequence.
